risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN) or have a compromised account.
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully logging into a PSN account and launching a game.

risks.risk: The console may have hardware faults such as the disc drive failing or the optical sensor broken.
risks.proof: A video showing the console booting up, navigating the system menu, and playing a game from a disc.

risks.risk: The games may be digital copies that cannot be redeemed or may be expired.
risks.proof: Photos of the physical game cases or screenshots of the digital library showing active accounts and games.

risks.risk: The console may be a refurbished unit with significant wear on the rear ports.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rear ports showing the condition of the HDMI, USB, and power cables.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the console booting up and playing a game.
Photo of the rear ports to check for damage.
Photos of the physical game cases or digital account screenshots.
Confirmation of the model number (e.g., PS4 Slim, PS4 Pro, or PS4 Core).
response.reason: What the item is shows, but not the model that sets its price: no photo shows it clearly enough to read. The shot asked for first would settle it.
